cover.title: 5 niche signs your best customers came from perplexity, not google

inner.title: two perplexity rows
inner.body: perplexity passes a referrer, listed as perplexity.ai and www.perplexity.ai, so look for both in your referral report. if you only scan the top three sources, a small row like that stays invisible.

inner.title: direct, but deep
inner.body: one study of about 450,000 ai-adjacent visits found 70.6% arrived with no referrer and landed as direct. direct visits that open deep pages are where your hidden ai customers sit.

inner.title: tiny but converting
inner.body: seer interactive (june 2025) had perplexity visitors converting at 10.5% against 1.76% for google organic. a source you call tiny can still be your best one.

inner.title: they stay and read
inner.body: one 2026 vendor report puts perplexity bounce at 21.4% against 71.4% for google, with sessions over 6 minutes. long sessions you can't explain come from a source you haven't named yet.

inner.title: no ai channel
inner.body: a custom ga4 channel group matching source on perplexity.ai and other assistants only works if you drag it to the top and leave medium open. until you build it, the customers who asked an ai about you have no name in your reports.
